label: Bible Study
prompt: The LORD _____; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
verse: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
note: From David's song of deliverance, sung after God rescued him from Saul — it's echoed in Psalm 18.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For the _____ is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
verse: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
note: God to Habakkuk: the vision will come; though it tarry, wait for it — it's on time, just not yours.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of _____: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
verse: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
note: 'Receipt of custom' was the tax booth — Matthew was on the job collecting taxes when Jesus said, 'Follow me.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Who is the image of the _____ God, the firstborn of every creature:
verse: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
note: Want to see the unseen God? Paul points to Christ — and the next verse says all things were created by him.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all _____ of no value.
verse: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.
note: Job to his three counselors: 'ye are all physicians of no value' — bad doctors with worse bedside manner.
